explanation: The angle of a forager's waggle run on the comb shows the food's direction relative to the Sun, and how long the run lasts shows the distance.

claims.text: Karl von Frisch decoded the waggle dance that honeybees use to tell nest-mates where food is.
Karl von Frisch shared the 1973 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine with Konrad Lorenz and Nikolaas Tinbergen.
Fireflies, ants and crickets do not tell nest-mates where food is by dancing; von Frisch's dance work was on honeybees.
The angle of the waggle run on the vertical comb shows the direction of the food relative to the Sun.
The duration of the waggle run shows the distance to the food.
